collision_check: Searched 188 openkit-*/fbx for tent|canvas|stake|guy|pavilion|peg|pole|grommet|punch|eyelet|coil. None of the 4 ids taken; no prior openkit-tent* pack. Near-misses: prop-tent-wedge (camp, finished tent), prop-tent-lean-to (outdoor, finished shelter), prop-rope-hook-stake (rope-maker), prop-peg-blank-tray (peg-maker), prop-rivet-eyelet-tray (pouch-maker), prop-eye-punch-die (needle-maker), rope/drawstring coils.
judgment_calls: Canvas panel is a flat unsewn 120x80 cm sheet with hems + chalk lines, no holes/poles - not a tent
Stake blank is a squared ash billet with axed 4-facet point and chalked-but-uncut notch, laid; distinct from turned peg-maker pegs and rope-hook-stake
Guy-line coil uses thick 24 mm hemp in 2 stacked turns + seizing + floor tail; chunkier than drawstring/rope coils
Grommet set is a tray of hollow punches + setting die + brass grommet blanks; distinct from pouch rivet-eyelet tray
Eye-check v2: no floating parts; tray walls lowered 4->2.5 cm so die/grommets read; laid stake rests on head and shaft (point tip ~2 cm off floor, as real)
